fundraising_headlines.title: Diginex Secures $70M Funding and Extends Acquisition Deadline
fundraising_headlines.summary: Diginex secured $70 million in private funding commitments and extended the long stop date for its proposed acquisition of Resulticks to August 12, 2026.

fundraising_headlines.title: Axis Origin Vault Fills $50M in 22 Hours, Raises Cap to $100M
fundraising_headlines.summary: Axis filled $50M in 22 hours, increasing Origin Vault cap to $100M at 1.75x multiplier. Closes August 5 or when filled.

fundraising_headlines.title: Matrix AI Network Raises $70M Seed Round Led by Index Ventures
fundraising_headlines.summary: Matrix AI Network raised $70M in seed funding led by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with Conviction participating, per TechCrunch.

fundraising_headlines.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5 Million for World ID Expansion
fundraising_headlines.summary: World Foundation raises $52.5M for World ID via WLD token sale led by Pantera Capital. Tokens locked 12 months to expand proof of human verification.

fundraising_headlines.title: Augustus Raises $180 Million Led by Tiger Global
fundraising_headlines.summary: Augustus secured $180 million in funding led by Tiger Global to expand dollar payment infrastructure, joined by Circle, Nubank, and others.

fundraising_headlines.title: Crypto.com Announces $400 Million Strategic Investment from Citadel Securities
fundraising_headlines.summary: Crypto.com announced a $400 million strategic investment from Citadel Securities.
